claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Oracle 後續一手（OCP、OFC、技術部落格）寫出 800G 世代 LPO 撤回或縮回到少數 hop。核查頻率：每次 OCP 高峰會與 OFC（每年兩次）。觸發後 48 小時：e1 降 confidence，重讀 LPO 層（tech:lpo）的需求側。
claims.statement: Oracle (buyer; Mark Filer, Architect, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) at OCP Global Summit 2026: 'Addressing TCO at 800G, OCI has large deployment of LPO transceivers in AI scale-out networks'; data set of identical T0<>T1 links, 156k LPO and 202k FRO (359k total); FRO links experienced 1.75x more transitions than LPO. Second hyperscaler running LPO in the AI back-end (after Meta). No LPO module or chipset vendor is named.

claims.disproof_condition: 條件：Oracle 或另一家雲端業者的一手寫出 1.6T 世代仍大量部署全線性 LPO（不是 LRO）。核查頻率：每次 OCP 高峰會與 OFC。觸發後 48 小時：e2 降 confidence，重讀 LPO 層與光模組 DSP 層的反向路徑。
claims.statement: Oracle at OCP 2026: 'LPO cannot comfortably meet SI and interop performance requirements at 1.6T; LRO provides the best low power solution currently available'; 'Interop has been demonstrated from different suppliers and multi-vendor 3nm DSPs'; takeaway 'LRO is viable at 1.6T'. LRO keeps a transmit-side DSP and a linear receive side, so at 1.6T (200G/lane) the buyer moves from fully linear LPO to half-linear LRO. Buyer's own technology choice, not a purchase order.

sources.quote: Mark Filer Architect, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
Addressing TCO at 800G, OCI has large deployment of LPO transceivers in AI scale-out networks
Plots show 24-hr max pre-FEC BER across identical T0<>T1 links, 156k LPO and 202k FRO in data set(359k total)
FRO links experienced 1.75x more transitions than LPO
LPO cannot comfortably meet SI and interop performance requirements at 1.6T; LRO provides the best low power solution currently available
Interop has been demonstrated from different suppliers and multi-vendor 3nm DSPs
Takeaway: LRO is viable at 1.6T and markedly improves network TCO for AI scale-out applications
